about: Start here chip on /scan-preview/. A hand-picked starter set: nine services ordered by each company's own most recent published count for the service, plus iCloud+, which has no published count, at a fixed unnumbered slot (third) so the default basket sits in the first screen. Counts measure different things; 'measure' quotes what the source counts and 'heading' names that measure on the panel. 'count' is the number the source states (a floor where it says 'over' or 'more than') and is used only to sort. null = no service-specific count published: no number, no source, never ranked, never called popular. Each tile is the service's entry plan; the count is for the whole service, never the plan. Separate from price sources in prices.json. Checked 2026-11-27.

items.note: Netflix stopped reporting quarterly counts in 2025; its 2026 letters give no newer total.
